FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No. 98/R&A Dated: 16th December, 2025
In continuation of this Court’s Notice No.62/R&A dated 02nd September, 2025, it is
hereby notified that:
1. In consideration of his prayer for granting extension, Sri Santosh Kumar (Roll
No.103052) is hereby granted another extension till 10.01.2026 to report for joining to
the post of Translator (SUVAS Cell) in the Recruitment & Appointment Cell of the
Court with all required documents as mentioned in his Appointment Letter, subject
to reckoning of his seniority from the date of joining with the stipulation that if he
does not join within the aforesaid period, his candidature would be deemed to have
been cancelled automatically.
2. Sri Govind Rajak (Roll No.103495), who has neither joined within stipulated time nor
prayed for extension of joining time, has been granted a last chance to report for
joining to the post of Translator (SUVAS Cell) under Translator and Translator-cum-
Proof Reader (For SUVAS Cell) Recruitment Examination, 2024 in the Recruitment
& Appointment Cell of the Court with all required documents as mentioned in his
Appointment Letter positively by 25.12.2025, subject to reckoning of his seniority
from the date of joining with the stipulation that if he does not join within the
aforesaid period, his candidature would be deemed to have been cancelled
automatically.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
